characters.summary: Superman Blue is an energy-based form of Superman who trades his physical strength for pure electromagnetic energy manipulation, allowing him to absorb various forms of energy and fire devastating electrical blasts.
limitations: Requires containment suit to maintain physical cohesion
Can be drained of energy by anti-energy technology
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard Kryptonian physical attributes with pure energy physiology, granting energy projection, absorption, and intangibility at the cost of vulnerability to energy-draining tech and the need for a containment suit.

sources.supports: Superman Blue origin, energy powers, and containment suit.

feats.claim: Absorbed massive amounts of energy to shut down an energy-based threat.

conditional.ability: Electromagnetic energy projection and phase shifting
conditional.dependsOn: Containment suit required to hold the energy form together

campaignTags.claim: Transformed into a being of pure electromagnetic energy capable of projecting electricity.
Controls and projects electromagnetic fields and lightning.
Retains the ability to fly as an energy being.

unknowns: Exact limits of energy absorption capacity before overload

characters.summary: Superman Red is the intellectual and energetic split counterpart of Superman Blue, focusing on high-level mental acuity, telekinetic applications, and focused energy constructs.
characters.formDifferences: Focuses the split energy form on telekinesis, logic, and construct generation rather than pure electrical blasts.

sources.supports: Superman Red splitting process and energy-based attributes.

feats.claim: Constructed complex energy devices on the fly using red electrical fields.

conditional.ability: Energy projection and maintenance of red energy form

campaignTags.claim: Composed of red electromagnetic energy.
Controls red electrical energy fields.
Retains flight capabilities.
Exhibits advanced telekinetic manipulation.

unknowns: Interactions between Red and Blue energy forms when combined

characters.summary: Swamp Thing is the avatar of the Green, wielding absolute control over plant life across the planet. He can regenerate endlessly from any vegetation, alter his size, and manipulate flora to ensnare or overwhelm opponents.

mechanisms: Regeneration from any plant matter on Earth

limitations: Power is severely limited in barren environments devoid of plant life

sources.supports: Swamp Thing origin, connection to the Green, and plant manipulation powers.

feats.claim: Reconstituted his entire body from a swamp after being completely incinerated.

notableResults.note: Easily bypassed Batman's defenses by possessing wooden structures.

campaignTags.claim: Can survive indefinitely underwater using plant biology.
Regenerates instantly using surrounding plant life.

unknowns: Full extent of control over alien plant life outside Earth's Green

characters.id: dc:Swamp Thing|Parliament of Trees Swamp Thing
characters.summary: As a member of the Parliament of Trees, this version of Swamp Thing holds deep ancestral wisdom and elevated dominion over the Green, operating as a planetary elder of plant elemental forces.

mechanisms: Instantaneous regeneration through global root networks

weaknesses: Destruction of the Parliament of Trees ecosystem
limitations: Tied to the well-being of the global plant ecosystem
characters.formDifferences: Gains deeper mystical connection and authority over the Green as a member of the Parliament of Trees, sacrificing individual mobility for planetary elemental awareness.

sources.supports: Parliament of Trees lore and Swamp Thing's status as an elder elemental.

feats.claim: Communed with and drew power directly from the collective consciousness of past plant avatars.

campaignTags.claim: Wields elemental magic tied to the Parliament of Trees.
Regenerates using global plant networks.

unknowns: Degree of separation from physical form while integrated into the Parliament

characters.summary: Talia al Ghul is a master tactician, martial artist, and assassin who commands the resources of the League of Assassins, utilizing advanced technology, poisons, and lethal hand-to-hand combat skills.
limitations: Subject to normal human physical limits

sources.supports: Talia al Ghul background as daughter of Ra's al Ghul, League of Assassins leader.

feats.claim: Successfully infiltrated heavily guarded Batcave security systems.

notableResults.note: Defeated in combat during strategic disagreements.

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes standard assassin gear and tracking devices.
Trained in League of Assassins stealth and infiltration techniques.

unknowns: Full current extent of access to Lazarus Pit resources

characters.summary: Ray Palmer is a physicist who can shrink himself and other objects down to subatomic levels using white dwarf star material, retaining his full physical mass to deliver devastating microscopic punches.

mechanisms: Microscopic size making him exceptionally difficult to target

weaknesses: Vulnerability to attacks while miniaturized if opponent detects him
mobility: Glide via air currents while tiny

sources.supports: Ray Palmer origin, white dwarf belt, and shrinking powers.

feats.claim: Traveled inside computer circuits and rewired electronic systems at the microscopic level.

conditional.dependsOn: Bio-belt powered by white dwarf star fragment

campaignTags.claim: Can shrink from normal human size down to subatomic levels.
Uses advanced bio-belt harnessing white dwarf star matter.
Equipped with miniaturization harness and scientific tools.

unknowns: Maximum duration of prolonged subatomic dimensional travel

characters.summary: Barry Allen is the Fastest Man Alive, drawing power from the Speed Force to run at lightspeed, time travel, phase through solid matter, and generate infinite mass punches.

mechanisms: Speed Force aura protecting against friction and G-forces

weaknesses: Absolute zero temperatures slowing molecular movement
limitations: Requires continuous physical motion or connection to Speed Force to maintain extreme feats

sources.supports: Barry Allen Speed Force connection, time travel, and phasing.

feats.claim: Ran across the globe and outran the gravitational pull of a collapsing black hole.

notableResults.note: Overcame Eobard Thawne by outrunning his paradox manipulation.

campaignTags.claim: Generates Speed Force lightning during movement.
Projects and redirects Speed Force lightning bolts.
Can run on air currents to simulate flight.
Can cross dimensional barriers via sheer velocity.

unknowns: Upper velocity limit before completely merging with the Speed Force

characters.id: dc:The Flash (Barry Allen)|Black Racer Barry Allen
characters.summary: When merged with the Black Racer, Barry Allen becomes the embodiment of death for gods and speedsters, wielding the Grim Reaper's touch that instantly ends immortal lives.

mechanisms: Invulnerability granted by the Black Racer entity

weaknesses: Separation from the Black Racer entity
Mind control or psychic separation techniques
limitations: Temporary fusion tied to specific crisis events
characters.formDifferences: Merges Barry Allen with the physical embodiment of death (Black Racer), replacing standard Speed Force lightning with lethal death-attuned energy capable of killing New Gods.

sources.supports: Black Racer merging with Barry Allen during the Darkseid War.

feats.claim: Used the Black Racer's touch to kill Darkseid during the Darkseid War.

notableResults.note: Used as a living weapon by Anti-Monitor to slay Darkseid.

conditional.ability: Instant death touch for gods and immortals
conditional.dependsOn: Active integration with the Black Racer entity

campaignTags.claim: Floats and moves with divine airborne agility.

unknowns: Long-term psychological strain of housing the death avatar
